input.text: Why did we move session-cache off Redis?

original_input.text: Why did we move session-cache off Redis?

final.answer: We moved session-cache off Redis to improve performance and reduce costs. Redis was becoming a bottleneck in our system, and moving the session-cache to a more lightweight solution allowed us to scale better and save on Redis licensing fees.
